|lore=Commander from Ralltiir. Fled from his homeworld after its occupation by the Empire. Was instrumental in the establishment of the new Rebel base on Hoth.
|joke=The card is a nod to [[Ralph McQuarrie]], the conceptual artist of the original ''Star Wars'' trilogy, and its picture is of McQuarrie. The character was not seen in the film.<ref name="ins74-51">"Hoth Freezes Over: Who's Who in Echo Base", ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' #74 (2004), p. 51. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/star-wars-insider-d0e5c1/page/n46/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref> See [[Jokes#General McQuarrie|Jokes]].
|game_text=While McQuarrie is on Hoth, your Hoth Sentry is not unique (•), is doubled, deploys free, applies all of its modifiers and is immune to Alter. Power -1 when not on Hoth.
